slides.title: Tigray party says its chairman was detained
slides.body: Court date set for Monday, Nov 23

slides.text: Tigray's **Tensae Sebha Enderta** party says chairman **Kebede Assefa** was taken into **federal police custody on Nov 19**.
The party says he appeared at the **Addis Ababa High Court** on **Nov 20** and got a new hearing date for **Monday**.
The party links it to its statement criticizing **caretaker administration appointments**. **No charge or official comment** was reported.
**Protect rights, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Ethiopia Insider, Nov 21, 2026 (party statement; not independently verified)
